name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.2 degrees south of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 13 times in 4 visits over 38 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 23 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 38 hours starting 2026-05-28, at wavelengths from 0.86 to 4.38 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
